purpose: Machine-readable inventory for Chaos Sea / Shining Abode pending, control, and meta lifecycle surfaces. This file is the audit baseline for issue #510; issue #511 migrates this data into runtime registry code.

surfaces.authority: GM-authored through afterlifeSpiritualConflictUpdate; canonical state is validator-normalized
surfaces.emptyWrapperSemantics: No empty wrapper is meaningful; stale afterlifeSpiritualConflictUpdate wrappers are stripped before projection.
surfaces.malformedBehavior: Fail closed; preserve raw payload for repair audit.
surfaces.blockerBehavior: Active conflicts block incarnation handoffs until resolve or repair_cancel terminal proof.
surfaces.closureSurface: afterlifeSpiritualConflictUpdate mode=resolve|repair_cancel moves terminal proof to recentConflicts or clears malformed state.
surfaces.notes: Meta response surface rather than game_state/control pending file.

surfaces.authority: GM-authored profile/update surfaces plus client-owned local player upgrade paths
surfaces.emptyWrapperSemantics: No empty wrapper semantics; absent legacy file is initialized/normalized as needed.
surfaces.malformedBehavior: Fail closed for malformed profile/update/custom-state/progression contracts.
surfaces.blockerBehavior: Does not block by existence; invalid profile updates block accepted-turn validation.
surfaces.closureSurface: afterlifeEntityProfileUpdates, afterlifeEntityCustomStateChanges, afterlifeSpecialArtLearningReceipts, afterlifeEntityProgressionOverrides.
surfaces.notes: Tracks entity currencies, progression, standard/special arts, custom states, and soul dissipation danger.

surfaces.notes: Cost-bearing Chaos Sea contract.
